thread:
Rohan: Heads up — console is showing the v2 migration badge for tenant `acme-inc` but routing logs show a bunch of v1 hits. Anyone seen this mismatch?
Maeve: I noticed that too this morning. looks like their clients are sending `X-Redwood-Client: 1.0.0` but console claim came from the admin flag.
Jess: Is the console badge sourced purely from the flagstore or from actual routing signal?
Maeve: Badge = flagstore. routing view = live router inference logs. they can be out of sync if the rollforward flag was flipped but the client handshake header hasn't propagated.
Tyler: That mismatch matters for quota accounting — if we display v2 and they think they've upgraded, they might hit unexpected token-shift. we should surface a small note: "routing still receiving v1 traffic". :warning:
Rohan: Agree. Also telemetry gap: current sampling only labels requests by `client_version` string, which is sometimes blank for SDK <0.9. We need a fallback: infer from `Accept` header or route fallback tag.
Jess: Proposal: add `routing_fingerprint` field in logs that encodes (header_version || route_variant || deduped-token-hash-first-8). keeps it short and joins console/telemetry.
Maeve: +1 on a fingerprint, but beware PII — token-hash piece must be irreversible. use HMAC with service key.
Tyler: Also need to show quota impact in console UI for the tenant: show both billed model variant (v1/v2) and routed variant in the per-route breakdown. UX simple: small two-line badge under model column.
ConsoleBot: Note created: https://console.redwood.internal/tasks/PLAT-1298 "Show routed vs billed model in tenant view" (assigned to @Maeve).
Rohan: For rollout UX, could we add a probe mode: "Display-only" that doesn't change quotas but warns clients? helps for staged rollouts.
Jess: We already have a shadow opt-in toggle for canaries. The missing bit is "display-only" mapping to not flip billing tags. small backend change to keep billing_version = previous and display_version = ephemeral.
Tyler: Quota edgecase: if display_version != billing_version, quota meters need to report on billing_version exclusively to avoid double-charging. Telemetry should include both fields though.
Maeve: Action items: 1) Add routing_fingerprint to log schema (Jess) 2) Implement HMAC token-hash helper (eng-security) 3) Console change to show both routed/billed variant and a small warning (Maeve) 4) Add "display-only" rollout toggle that doesn't alter billing (Rohan + platform infra)
Rohan: I'll open the RFC for display-only toggle. quick question: sampling rate for the new fingerprint — start at 1% across all traffic and up to 10% for tenants in active rollouts?
Jess: 1% global, 5% for rollout cohorts sounds right. Also add a top-level metric `routing_fingerprint_mismatch` when display_version != routed_version.
Tyler: Can we emit an alert if mismatch rate > 10% for > 30m for any single tenant? operationally useful.
Maeve: Yep — add alert: PLAT-1299. set Slack channel `#eng-oncall` and severity P2.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: router-config v2026.03.21-47 -> prod (rolling).
Rohan: Good timing — once router-config is up we can validate fingerprint presence in logs. I'll coordinate smoke test with support for a couple of tenants.
Maeve: Thanks all — I'll post a short console banner copy for legal/marketing to sign off before we ship the UI. :thumbsup:
Jess: I'll add the schema change to the telemetry PR and include example kql for analysts.
Tyler: Leaving note: remember to update billing docs — this display-only mode is a policy change.
Rohan: Cool. follow-ups in PLAT-1298/1299 and my RFC.
Maeve: Closing loop here — ping if you need reviews.
